effective_date_basis: Event X1-E2's sources once held; or an earlier end (an amended or superseding code order).
ending_pattern: Candidate end: the code-making authority under NIRA Title I fell with Schechter (May 27, 1935) and the Title's expiry (June 16, 1935, as extended in skeleton form to April 1, 1936). See event X1-E2. The agent decides the date per order.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Penalties already incurred and actions taken are accrued effects; later statutes (for example the Bituminous Coal Act) are independent.

exemplar.wpa_summary: Code of Fair Competition for the Commercial Ref riger-ator Industry approved. IV NRA Codes 441.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
Administrative orders on NRA boards and personnel (not code approvals).
